nativeglengine.name: NativeGLEngine
nativeglengine.description: Native rendering engine for Android Minecraft Java
nativeglengine.config.title: NativeGLEngine Configuration
nativeglengine.config.shader.cache.toolt: Enable persistent SPIR-V/ESSL shader cache (SHA-256). Eliminates shader compilation stutter on startup.
nativeglengine.config.shader.async.toolt: Compile shaders asynchronously off the render thread. A placeholder shader is shown during compilation.
nativeglengine.config.shader.threads.too: Number of threads dedicated to shader compilation. 1-2 recommended on mobile.
nativeglengine.config.hooks.enabled.tool: Enable PLT hooking on OpenGL calls. Requires native library (.so). Disable if crashing.
nativeglengine.config.hooks.stateDedup.t: Filter redundant glEnable/glDisable calls. Saves 2-5ms per frame with many entities.
nativeglengine.config.hooks.textureThrot: Queue texture uploads when GPU budget is tight. Prevents 5-15ms freezes during chunk loading.
nativeglengine.config.memory.monitor.too: Monitor GPU memory budget via VMA + VK_EXT_memory_budget. Requires native library.
nativeglengine.config.debug.hud.tooltip: Display NativeGLEngine stats overlay: renderer, cache hits, GPU pressure.
